pipeline.title: Eight stages.
pipeline.description: Every message your brand receives passes through a fully audited AI pipeline before a single word is published. Scroll to walk through each stage.
pipeline.detailHoverHint: Scroll to walk through each stage.

stages.label: Qualify
stages.description: Determines whether AI should respond. Filters spam, bot activity, and out-of-scope interactions before spending any LLM tokens.

stages.label: Classify
stages.description: amt-intel detects purchase intent, sentiment, language, and interaction type with fine-grained confidence scoring.

stages.label: Retrieve
stages.description: amt-rag performs semantic vector search over your brand knowledge base using pgvector embeddings.

stages.label: Compose
stages.description: LLM provider generates a brand-voice reply grounded in retrieved context and brand persona configuration.

stages.label: Guard
stages.description: amt-guard runs 9 parallel safety checks: PII, price validation, toxicity, duplicates, leak prevention, and more.

stages.label: Evaluate
stages.description: amt-eval scores response quality 0–100 across coherence, tone match, helpfulness, and accuracy.

stages.label: Trust Gate
stages.detail: L1 Full Review → L4 Full Auto
stages.description: amt-trust applies your brand's trust level (L1–L4) to decide: auto-publish, queue for review, or reject.

stages.label: Publish
stages.description: amt-comms publishes to Instagram via the official API with full audit trail and pipeline trace.

trustRamp.title: Start careful.
trustRamp.description: Qaqnuz grows into autonomy alongside your brand. The trust ramp means you're never forced to give up control — you earn it, level by level.

levels.name: Full Review
levels.description: Every AI-composed reply sits in the approval queue. Your operator reviews and edits before anything reaches the customer. Zero risk — ideal for brand onboarding.
features: No LLM responses published without sign-off

levels.name: Guided Auto
levels.description: High-confidence, low-risk replies (FAQs, hours, location queries) publish automatically. Anything with purchase intent, pricing, or complaint signals queues for review.

levels.name: Smart Auto
levels.description: The AI handles most interactions autonomously, including sales conversations. Only escalations and edge cases route to your team. Full guardrails remain active.

levels.name: Full Auto
levels.description: Near-complete autonomy for established brands. The AI runs your DMs 24/7. Human oversight is available on-demand, not in the critical path. 9-point guardrails never sleep.

guardrails.title: 9 guardrails.
guardrails.description: Before any AI reply reaches your customer, it must pass nine parallel safety checks. All nine. Every time. There are no exceptions — the guardrails run even in full-auto mode.
guardrails.bottomNote: All 9 checks run in parallel via amt-guard — adding zero latency to the pipeline.

items.title: PII Detection
items.description: Automatically detects and redacts personal information — phone numbers, addresses, national IDs — before any response is composed or published.

items.title: Price Validation
items.description: Cross-references quoted prices against your live product catalog. Prevents AI from promising incorrect discounts or out-of-date pricing.

items.title: Toxicity Filter
items.description: Multi-lingual toxicity detection (Uzbek + Russian + English). Ensures AI responses remain professional even when customers don't.

items.title: Duplicate Detection
items.description: Identifies repeated messages and near-duplicate responses to prevent spam, reply loops, and the uncanny feeling of talking to a broken bot.

items.title: Leak Prevention
items.description: Stops the AI from disclosing internal pricing strategies, supplier details, unreleased products, or any information flagged as confidential.

items.title: Competitor Mention
items.description: Detects references to competitor brands and either deflects gracefully or escalates to a human — no accidental competitor endorsements.

items.title: Off-Topic Guard
items.description: Keeps the AI on-brand and on-topic. Rejects responses that drift outside your configured business scope, preventing hallucinations from leaking through.

items.title: Length Validation
items.description: Enforces configurable character limits. No response too terse to be useful, and no wall-of-text that kills the conversation.

items.title: Compliance Check
items.description: Flags responses that could expose the brand to regulatory issues — false advertising, unverifiable guarantees, or legally sensitive language.

dashboard.title: Six panels.

panels.label: Queue
panels.description: Proactive action approval queue. Review, edit, approve, or reject AI-generated responses. One-click publish or send back for recomposition.

panels.label: Analytics

faq.title: Common questions.
faq.description: Everything you need to know before booking a demo.

items.a: Qaqnuz is an AI-native automation platform that manages Instagram DMs, comments, and story mentions for Uzbekistan-based brands. It runs every incoming message through an 8-stage AI pipeline — qualify, classify, retrieve, compose, guard, evaluate, trust gate, publish — with 9 safety checks on every response. Operators retain full control through the Mission Control dashboard, with human override always one click away.

Most brands are live within 1–3 business days. The setup process involves connecting your Instagram Business account, configuring your brand profile (voice, products, FAQs, guardrails), and starting at Trust Level L1 where every response is reviewed before publishing. Your customer success manager guides you through onboarding.

Qaqnuz natively supports Uzbek (Latin script), Russian, and English. The AI classifies the language of each incoming message and responds in the same language. Mid-conversation language switches are handled automatically. There is no translation step — the AI works natively in all three languages.

Pricing is based on the number of Instagram accounts and monthly message volume. All plans include the full 8-stage pipeline and 9 safety guardrails — you pay for scale, not for features. Contact us for a customized quote. We do not charge per API call or per LLM token — cost governance is handled internally with configurable per-brand budgets.

items.q: How does Qaqnuz handle customer data and privacy?
items.a: Customer messages are processed in real-time and not stored beyond your configured retention period. PII is detected and handled according to your compliance settings. Customers can opt out of AI responses at any time by sending the STOP keyword — their account is flagged immediately and all future messages route to a human operator. We do not use customer data to train models.

items.q: Is the AI transparent with customers — do they know they're talking to AI?
items.a: AI disclosure is configurable per brand. You can set Qaqnuz to include a disclosure message in its first reply, add a note in the brand bio, or operate without disclosure (where local regulations permit). We recommend transparency and provide templated disclosure language in Uzbek, Russian, and English.

Qaqnuz integrates with Instagram Business API (DMs, comments, story mentions), Click, Payme, Uzum, and Humo payment systems, and Telegram for operator notifications. The platform is designed as a standalone system — it does not require third-party CRM integration to function, though export APIs are available in the Enterprise tier.

items.q: What kind of support does Qaqnuz offer?
items.a: All plans include onboarding assistance and documentation. Growth plans include priority email/chat support with a dedicated customer success manager. Enterprise plans include an SLA, named account support, and a dedicated Slack or Telegram channel with your team.
